zh.title: SKYTICAL團隊
zh.description: 認識SKYTICAL創辦人neo，以及這個由一人獨立營運、免費分享航空新聞的網站背後的故事。
zh.heading: 航空世界很大，從一份好奇開始。
zh.name: neo
zh.role: 創辦人・營運與維護顧問
zh.intro: 我是neo，歡迎來到SKYTICAL。從興趣使然架設的新聞網站開始，讓SKYTICAL成為與大家分享航空大小事的地方。
zh.photoCaption: 航空、攝影、音樂，還有路上的風景。

sections.title: 從自己想看的新聞網站開始
body: 我一直對航空業發生的大小事充滿興趣，但航空資訊往往散落在各家航空公司、各國民航主管機關與媒體之間。許多消息又具有時效性，等到偶然看到時，可能早已錯過最值得關注的時刻。
因此，我建立了SKYTICAL，希望透過全自動新聞聚合，將分散的航空消息整理在一起，免費提供給讀者，讓大家更方便掌握航空界的重要動態、產業消息，以及令人好奇的話題與幕後故事。
最初，這只是一個做給自己看的新聞網站。隨著功能逐漸增加，網站也越來越實用，我才開始希望將它分享給更多讀者，以及同樣關心航空世界的朋友。

sections.title: 一個人營運，也持續往前
body: 從網站開發、功能規劃，到日常營運、更新與維護，目前都由我一人負責。
身為學生，能投入的時間有限，但我會持續在課業與網站之間找到平衡，盡力讓SKYTICAL保持更新、穩定運作，也讓每一次調整都更貼近讀者的需要。

sections.title: 航空之外的我
body: 土生土長臺北人，目前也在臺北念大學。從小在松山機場附近長大，雖然到大學才開始對飛機產生興趣。比起以「航空迷」介紹自己，我更喜歡說，自己是對國內外整個航空產業充滿好奇的aviation enthusiast。
航空之外，我也喜愛攝影、音樂與旅遊，平時喜歡開車或騎車出去兜風走走追日落、看夜景、逛展覽，像外星人般探索這個世界。
我喜歡的音樂人有Frank Ocean和Daniel Caesar，keshi與Joji也是心頭好，來自澳洲的Royel Otis、美國的LANY和Cigarettes After Sex也是我的愛，當然不能忘了周董周杰倫還有Abel。
音樂陪我度過日常，也陪著我忙裡偷閒把SKYTICAL一點一點做起來。

zh.closing: 謝謝你來到SKYTICAL，一起關心航空世界的下一件事。

en.title: SKYTICAL Team
en.description: Meet neo, the founder behind SKYTICAL, an independently operated website sharing aviation news free of charge.
en.heading: A world of aviation. A spark of curiosity.
en.name: neo
en.intro: I'm neo. Welcome to SKYTICAL. This website began as a personal interest project, and I'm building it into a place to share the aviation world with everyone.
en.photoAlt: Portrait of neo, founder of SKYTICAL
en.photoCaption: Aviation, photography, music, and the places along the way.

sections.title: It started with the news I wanted to read
body: I've always been curious about what's happening across aviation. But the information is scattered among airlines, civil aviation authorities around the world, and the media. Much of it is time-sensitive; by the time I happened to find a story, the moment to follow it had often passed.

That's why I built SKYTICAL: a fully automated news aggregator that brings those scattered updates together, free for readers. I wanted to make it easier to keep up with major developments, industry news, interesting conversations, and the stories behind them.
At first, this was simply a news website for myself. As its features grew and it became more useful, I began to want to share it with other readers and anyone equally curious about aviation.

sections.title: One person, keeping things moving
body: From development and feature planning to day-to-day operations, updates, and maintenance, I currently look after the whole website myself.
As a student, my time is limited. I'm working to balance my studies with the website, keeping SKYTICAL updated and running reliably, and making each improvement more useful to its readers.

sections.title: Beyond aviation
body: Born and raised in Taipei, I'm currently attending university here too. I grew up near Songshan Airport, although it wasn't until university that I became interested in planes. Rather than introducing myself as an aviation fan, I prefer to say I'm an aviation enthusiast curious about the entire industry, both in Taiwan and around the world.

Beyond aviation, I love photography, music, and travel. I also enjoy heading out for drives or rides, chasing sunsets, taking in night views, and visiting exhibitions, exploring this world like an alien.

My favorite musicians include Frank Ocean and Daniel Caesar, with keshi and Joji also close to my heart. I also love Australia's Royel Otis, America's LANY and Cigarettes After Sex, and, of course, Jay Chou and Abel.
Music keeps me company through everyday life and as I steal little moments from a busy schedule to build SKYTICAL, bit by bit.

en.closing: Thanks for being here. Let's keep following what happens next in aviation.
